entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Binyamin Gibli was an Israeli general who served as the head of Israeli Military Intelligence from June 1950 to March 1955. Gibli was forced to resign in the wake of the Lavon Affair, a failed Israeli operation in Egypt in 1954.
